title: Implement Trust Indicators section variants (trust-bar, trust-grid)
description: Implement two Trust Indicators variants. trust-bar shows items in a horizontal scrolling bar (e.g. '500+ customers', 'Licensed & Insured', '24/7 Service'). trust-grid shows them in a 2x3 or 3x2 grid with larger icons.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: TrustIndicatorsContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Each item renders icon/emoji (if present), value, and label
trust-bar is horizontal with dividers between items
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Horizontal flex container with `overflow-x-auto`. Each item: centered, icon above value, label below. Vertical dividers between items on desktop. Background: `--color-surface-alt`. Compact height (~100-120px).
Grid `grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3`. Each cell: large icon/number, label below. More spacious than TrustBar. Background: `--color-background`.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify items are visible and layout is correct for both variants.
